name: grokpair
description: Delegate bounded work to a detached Grok Build collaborator (research, review, an implementation in its own worktree, documents or media), keep working, then read what Grok said and made.

interface.shortDescription: Grok as a detached collaborator while you work.
interface.longDescription: Hand a detached Grok Build collaborator a complete brief (research, a review, an implementation in its own worktree, a document or media) and keep working. Wait for its result, read what Grok said and made, continue the same conversation, answer its questions, redirect or close it. You keep acceptance, integration and every claim.
defaultPrompt: Ask Grok to review this change read-only while I keep working, then read its findings.
Have Grok research this question with sources; wait for its result and check the key claims.
Give Grok a worktree to draft an alternative implementation, then inspect its diff.
